sources.entry: Beaver Habit Tracker - Habit tracking app to save your precious moments in your fleeting life. (Demo) BSD-3-Clause Docker

summary.one_liner: Beaver Habit Tracker is a self-hosted habit tracking app that avoids "Goals," with a Docker image and a hosted cloud option.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes a self-hosted habit tracker, with a cloud (SaaS) version also offered. It can be run with Docker or Docker Compose, with habit data stored either in a single SQLite database (habits.db) or in a local JSON file via the USER_DISK option. Configuration is done through environment variables, including skipping authentication for a trusted local email, customizing how many date columns the index page shows, and enabling an iOS standalone mode. It can also be deployed on Unraid (via Community Apps) and Easypanel (via a one-click template). The README lists several derivatives: a Stream Deck integration (HabitDeck), an Apple Shortcut, a Home Assistant switch, a CalDAV bridge that exposes habits as tasks, and an offline-first iOS native app. Full feature details are said to be on the project wiki, and the app is inspired by the Android app Loop Habit Tracker.
use_cases: run a habit tracker in Docker
sync habits to tasks via CalDAV
mark habits done from Stream Deck or Home Assistant
how_to_run: Or use Docker Compose with the image daya0576/beaverhabits:latest, port 8080:8080, and a volume mapped to /app/.user/
Unraid: search for 'Beaver Habit Tracker' in Community Apps
Easypanel: deploy using the official one-click template
notable: Storage choice between SQLite database and local JSON files
Multiple integrations: Stream Deck, Home Assistant, CalDAV, Apple Shortcut
Runs as non-root user, OpenShift compatible
caveats: File permissions: host folder UID must match the container user UID to avoid issues
Several derivatives (e.g. iOS native app, CalDAV bridge) are separate projects, not confirmed as bundled features
Cloud service has paid pricing plans
